_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); gas distribution and midstream signals with ONEOK's rule-T thresholds

pit_profile.why: 'We are a diversified energy company and successor to the company founded in 1906 known as Oklahoma Natural Gas Company.' 'Our cash flow depends heavily on the earnings and distributions of ONEOK Partners.' 'The volatility of natural gas, crude oil and NGL prices could affect adversely ONEOK Partners’ cash flow.' (the FY2011 10-K's own words; it calls no business of the company cyclical, the word appearing only in its billing cycle, so DURABLE, the MU rule); no disruption theme in the registry is live for a gas distributor and midstream company on this date (of the live themes, OFFSHORE is scoped to 'lower-cost offshore delivery (Indian IT services) takes share and price from Western consulting, systems integration and outsourcing', CLOUD to 'public cloud displaces on-premise hardware, storage, legacy databases and data-center outsourcing': none names gas distribution or midstream), so the watch list is empty

classification.quality_note: 'We are a diversified energy company and successor to the company founded in 1906 known as Oklahoma Natural Gas Company.' 'Our cash flow depends heavily on the earnings and distributions of ONEOK Partners.' 'The volatility of natural gas, crude oil and NGL prices could affect adversely ONEOK Partners’ cash flow.' (the FY2011 10-K's own words; it calls no business of the company cyclical, the word appearing only in its billing cycle, so DURABLE, the MU rule); no disruption theme in the registry is live for a gas distributor and midstream company on this date (of the live themes, OFFSHORE is scoped to 'lower-cost offshore delivery (Indian IT services) takes share and price from Western consulting, systems integration and outsourcing', CLOUD to 'public cloud displaces on-premise hardware, storage, legacy databases and data-center outsourcing': none names gas distribution or midstream), so the watch list is empty. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price rich; +154% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap -2.12; conservative 2yr -44%.

BEAR.desc: EPS -5.1%/yr (worst year FY02-FY11, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS -14.9%/yr (Q3 revenues + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +11.4%/yr (FY02-FY11 CAGR, at least BASE); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +30.0%/yr (best 2-yr run FY02-FY11, at least BULL); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: OKE (retrospective, 2013-02-08) ✕ AVOID — Ratio B infx (68.6% downside to Bear $15 / +-22.6% upside to Bull $37) | Adj composite 1.65 vs market 3.77: gap -2.12 [OVERVALUED] | +153% above the EPP floor $19 (11x FY12E $1.72) | Conservative 2-yr case: -43.6% total (-21.8%/yr) | At 27.9x FY12E the 15% hurdle price $63 sits above the BULL case; net margin +4.0% and Distribution operating income -20.7% in Q3 2012, forward revenues -14.2% (no FY12 revenue guide in numbers, Q3 2012 revenues as reported); no theme in the registry is live for a gas distributor and midstream company on this date (CLOUD and OFFSHORE are scoped to IT).
